BiblicalUsage: A flock is sheep or goats gathered and kept, and the Bible's shepherds watch them day and night. Jacob waters the flocks at the well in Haran, David tells Saul he killed a lion and a bear to save a lamb from his father's flock, and Isaiah says the Lord will feed His flock like a shepherd and carry the lambs in His arms. The flock is never just animals; it is the picture of God's people under His care.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe I am one of His flock, and that changes how I hear His voice, because sheep know the shepherd and follow him. He carries the lambs, and I am glad to be carried.
